Wormadam

Bug Grass

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Wormadam is a Bug/Grass-type Bagworm Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 6.5 kg. It evolves from Burmy. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (105), with a base stat total of 424.
